_note: One-line notes of the Vorax surgical instruments, in our own words, shown when the mouse rests on an instrument in the panel. Keyed by solver id (crates/vorax/data/game.json). Checked against the card text of real games and the simulation (crates/vorax/src/effects.rs) on 2026-11-12.

1.zh: 回合結束時，設蠱蟲組數為 X，隨機怪物 +8 數量，共 X×X 次（同一組可重複中）。
1.en: At round end, with X groups of Pests, +8 Quantity to a random group, X×X times (a group can be hit again).

2.zh: 有至少 2 組蠱蟲時，每新增一組怪物，所有怪物 +45 數量。
2.en: With at least 2 groups of Pests, +45 Quantity to all monsters each time a monster is added.

3.zh: 有至少 2 組覺醒者時，每回合結束隨機 1 組稀有或首領怪物 +80 活性。
3.en: With at least 2 groups of Agitoes, +80 Activity to 1 random Rare or Boss monster each round.

4.zh: 有稀有或首領覺醒者時，每回合結束隨機 1 組怪物 +80 活性。
4.en: With a Rare or Boss Agito, +80 Activity to 1 random group each round.

5.zh: 有至少 2 組骨衛兵時，每移除一組怪物，隨機 1 組怪物 +180 數量。
5.en: With at least 2 groups of Bone Sentries, +180 Quantity to 1 random group each time a monster is removed.

6.zh: 移除非骨衛兵的怪物時，隨機 1 組怪物 +150 數量。
6.en: When a monster other than a Bone Sentry is removed, +150 Quantity to 1 random group.

7.zh: 有怪物變異成異魔時，所有怪物 +35 活性。
7.en: When a monster mutates into an Aemberon, +35 Activity to all monsters.

8.zh: 有至少 2 組異魔時，每次怪物變異，所有怪物 +20 活性。
8.en: With at least 2 groups of Aemberons, +20 Activity to all monsters on every mutation.

9.zh: 有至少 3 組蠱蟲時，每回合結束新增 1 組蠱蟲（稀有度隨機），並給它 +100 數量。
9.en: With at least 3 groups of Pests, add 1 Pest group (random rarity) with +100 Quantity each round.

10.zh: 回合結束時，隨機 2 組魔法怪物融合成 1 組稀有覺醒者（少於 2 組魔法就不發動）。
10.en: At round end, 2 random Magic monsters fuse into 1 Rare Agito (needs 2 Magic groups).

11.zh: 回合結束時，若有至少 2 組骨衛兵，移除總活性最低的非骨衛兵怪物，並把它的活性和數量加到隨機 1 組骨衛兵。
11.en: At round end, with at least 2 Bone Sentries, remove the non-Bone-Sentry with the lowest total; a random Bone Sentry gains its Activity and Quantity.

12.zh: 每新增一組怪物，有 75% 機率讓它變異成異魔並 +80 活性。
12.en: Each added monster has a 75% chance to mutate into an Aemberon and gain +80 Activity.

13.zh: 有 3 組（含以上）魔法怪物時，每回合結束總活性最高的 1 組 +100 數量。
13.en: With 3 or more Magic groups, +100 Quantity to the group with the highest total each round.

14.zh: 回合結束時，同一稀有度每湊滿 3 組，就融合成 1 組高一階稀有度的怪物。
14.en: At round end, every 3 monsters of the same rarity fuse into 1 monster one rarity higher.

15.zh: 回合結束時，數量和活性都大於 150 的怪物 +15 活性、+15 數量。
15.en: At round end, +15 Activity and +15 Quantity to monsters with both above 150.

16.zh: 新增怪物時若超過培養皿上限，總活性最低的 1 組 +25 活性、+25 數量。
16.en: When an added monster goes past the tank limit, +25 Activity and +25 Quantity to the lowest-total group.

17.zh: 回合結束時，數量大於 275 的怪物都 +20 活性。
17.en: At round end, +20 Activity to every monster with Quantity above 275.

18.zh: 回合結束時，活性大於 255 的怪物都 +30 數量。
18.en: At round end, +30 Quantity to every monster with Activity above 255.

19.zh: 每 2 回合（從取得那回合算起），每個稀有度各隨機 1 組怪物升一階稀有度。
19.en: Every 2 rounds from its pick, 1 random monster of each rarity awakens one rarity higher.

20.zh: 每 3 回合（從取得那回合算起），所有怪物變異成隨機種族。
20.en: Every 3 rounds from its pick, every monster mutates into a random archetype.

21.zh: 同時有普通、魔法和稀有（或首領）怪物時，每回合結束所有怪物 +20 活性。
21.en: With Normal, Magic and Rare (or Boss) monsters at once, +20 Activity to all monsters each round.

22.zh: 移除怪物時，總活性最高的 1 組 +20 活性、+20 數量。
22.en: When a monster is removed, +20 Activity and +20 Quantity to the highest-total group.

23.zh: 回合結束時，有 2～5 組怪物就新增 1 組隨機怪物；滿 6 組時，總活性最高的吞掉最低的。
23.en: At round end, with 2 to 5 groups add 1 random monster; with 6, the highest total devours the lowest.

24.zh: 有 3 組（含以上）普通怪物時，每回合結束所有怪物 +30 數量。
24.en: With 3 or more Normal groups, +30 Quantity to all monsters each round.

25.zh: 每 3 回合（從取得那回合算起），隨機 2 組蠱蟲融合成 1 組蠱蟲（稀有度隨機）。
25.en: Every 3 rounds from its pick, 2 random Pests fuse into 1 Pest of random rarity.
